<noinclude>{{Documentation subpage}}</noinclude>
This is a template link with a variable number of example parameters (0–30), which can be used to show example inputs.
== Syntax ==
=== Parameters ===
;First parameter
:The link to the template. Defaults to the page name (current page name: '''{{PAGENAME}}''')

;2nd to 31st parameter
:The parameters of the template.

:To add named parameters, example <code><nowiki>{{notice|1st parameter|2nd parameter|3=3rd parameter}}</nowiki></code>, follow these steps:
:# Write the parameter normally. Example: <code><nowiki>{{tlx|Documentation|1st parameter|2nd parameter|3=3rd parameter}}</nowiki></code>.
:# Then, count how many parameters you have added, so <code>{<nowiki/>{t|''notice''|''1st parameter''|''2nd parameter''|'''3=3rd parameter'''}}</code>. <br/> On this example, there are '''4''' parameters, so prefix <code>4=</code> on the {{tlx|tlx}} template.
:# So, the code is <code>{<nowiki/>{t|notice|1st parameter|2nd parameter|'''''4='''=3=3rd parameter''}}</code>, which results in {{tlx|Documentation|1st parameter|2nd parameter|4=3=3rd parameter}}.

:Note: Adding named parameters will force you to always prefix the unnamed parameter:
::<code><nowiki>{{tlx|Documentation|1st parameter|2nd parameter|4=3=3rd parameter|4th parameter}}</nowiki></code> will '''not work'''
::<code><nowiki>{{tlx|Documentation|1st parameter|2nd parameter|4=3=3rd parameter|5=4th parameter}}</nowiki></code> '''will work'''.
----
The following will only work after all the parameters of the demo template is placed.<br/>
'''Wrong''': <nowiki>{{tlx|Documentation|style=code|<message>}}</nowiki><br/>
'''Right''': <nowiki>{{tlx|Documentation|<message>|style=code}}</nowiki>

;Style (<code>style=</code>)
:The style of the {{tlx|tlx}} template. Has 1 style:
:* <code>code</code>, which encloses the {{tlx|tlx}} template with <code><nowiki><code></nowiki></code>

;Prefix (<code>prefix=</code>)
:The prefix for the template, useful when instructing the user to add <code>subst</code>, <code>safesubst</code>, or something similar.
:Note: This '''does not''' add a prefix to the link. Use <code>linkprefix</code> instead as listed below.

;Link Prefix (<code>linkprefix=</code>)
:The prefix for the link itself, for linking to other languages/wikis. Also shows in the template link.
:Note: This adds the prefix to the link itself. To add a prefix not included on the link, see above.

;Block Mode (<code>block=</code>)
:Makes the template styled as a block template, to aid in readability. Combine with <code>style=code</code> to get the best results.

=== Sample code ===
{| class="wikitable"
!Syntax
!Output
|-
|<code><nowiki>{{tlx}}</nowiki></code>
|{{tlx}} (uses the page name)
|-
|<code><nowiki>{{tlx|Documentation}}</nowiki></code>
|{{tlx|Documentation}}
|-
|<code><nowiki>{{tlx|Documentation|Item1|Item2|Item3|Item4|Item5|...}}</nowiki></code>
|{{tlx|Documentation|Item1|Item2|Item3|Item4|Item5|...}}
|-
|<code><nowiki>{{tlx|Documentation|2=param1=Item1}}</nowiki></code>
|{{tlx|Documentation|2=param1=Item1}}
|-
|<code><nowiki>{{tlx|Documentation|prefix=subst}}</nowiki></code>
|{{tlx|Documentation|prefix=subst}}
|-
|<code><nowiki>{{tlx|Documentation|linkprefix=w}}</nowiki></code>
|{{tlx|Documentation|linkprefix=w}}
|-
|<code><nowiki>{{tlx|Documentation|style=code}}</nowiki></code>
|{{tlx|Documentation|style=code}}
|-
|<code><nowiki>{{tlx|Documentation|2=Item1|3=Item2|4=Item3|block=true}}</nowiki></code>
|{{tlx|Documentation|2=Item1|3=Item2|4=Item3|block=true}}
|}
